verdict.rationale: BugSnag has an official MCP server in SmartBear's own smartbear-mcp repository (SmartBear is BugSnag's parent). The BugSnag changelog confirms ongoing first-party investment, adding OAuth 2.0 browser-based login for the self-hosted MCP server so agents can connect without manual API tokens. Missing for 10: details of the BugSnag-specific tools and capabilities the server exposes, setup and client-configuration docs in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent connections.
